# Support

## How to file issues and get help

This project uses **GitHub Issues** to track bugs and feature requests.

1. **Search**: Please [search existing issues](https://github.com/STS-Consulting/PowerShell/issues) before filing new ones to avoid duplicates.
2. **File an Issue**:
    - [Bug Report](https://github.com/STS-Consulting/PowerShell/issues/new?template=bug-report.md)
    - [Feature Request](https://github.com/STS-Consulting/PowerShell/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)
    - [Accessibility Challenge](https://github.com/STS-Consulting/PowerShell/issues/new?template=accessibility-challenge.md)
3. **Discussions**: Join the [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/STS-Consulting/PowerShell/discussions) (if enabled) or ask questions in issues.

**Note**: Support is limited as this is a personal project maintained in free time.
